info.title: Coderax WorkflowEngine API
info.description: Authoritative HTTP surface for Coderax Native intelligence, agent orchestration and durable Work execution. Every operation is generated from the versioned route catalogue.

get.summary: Liveness and dependency health for the engine.
Whether the engine finished startup validation.
Discover the three agent identities and their truthful availability.
Discover models, cost class and the zero-cost route.

post.summary: One Chat turn. Streams SSE frames when the client accepts them.
Submit a durable Work task; returns before execution finishes.

get.summary: Authoritative task status, including terminal state and failure.

post.summary: Request cancellation. Safe from any replica and after disconnect.
Resume a suspended or interrupted task from its last checkpoint.
Retry a failed task on the same engine with a new generation.

get.summary: Replay and tail execution events from a sequence cursor.
Conversation history shared by web and CLI clients.
One conversation with its persisted messages.
Owner-scoped memory for the requested data mode.
Pending and decided permission requests for a task.

post.summary: Approve or deny one scoped permission request.

get.summary: Truthful status of Native Game Studio and Native Gaming Agent, with evidence.
Owner-scoped, persistent game projects.

post.summary: Create a game project from a natural-language specification.

get.summary: One game project with its latest build and design plan.

post.summary: Replace the design spec at an expected revision.
Generate original source, assets and levels, then verify playability.

200.description: Verified or failed build with evidence

get.summary: Owner-scoped build history, newest first.

post.summary: Restore a verified historical build and the exact spec it was built from.
Apply a natural-language edit, rebuild and re-verify.

get.summary: Playable HTML preview of the latest verified build.
Export the verified source as a deterministic ZIP archive.

post.summary: Start an isolated gaming-agent session against a verified build.

get.summary: Owner-scoped gaming-agent sessions.
Session status, bounded progress, memory and recent logs.
Screen frame and inspected game state for the current tick.

post.summary: Pause, resume, take over, release, cancel or send one bounded input.

get.summary: Bounded execution log and session memory.
Measured objective completion evidence for a finished session.
Durable completion notifications, including unread count.
